name: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild (and Tears of the Kingdom)
short_description: Explore a huge ruined kingdom freely: climb anything, glide, cook, fight and solve shrines with physics.
sources: oracle study 2026-10-23 (public knowledge, no store fetch, no game files)
summary: Explore a huge ruined kingdom freely: climb anything, glide, cook, fight and solve shrines with physics.

identity.core_loop: See something on the horizon, go there, climb and glide, find a shrine or a fight, cook and gear up, repeat.
identity.ui_and_game_feel: Free and physical; the world answers with chemistry and physics.

hud_coverage.method: Oracle study from public knowledge of the game, in our own words; not yet measured on capture

information_grammar.note: Stamina is a wheel next to Link only while you use it; heat, cold and noise show on the body and the screen edge; the world (towers, smoke, birds) shows where to go.

identity.art_direction: Painterly, softly shaded world with gentle outlines on characters and big atmospheric haze.

rendering.source: derived from the art note by rendering_notes.RULES

tricks: About eight directional climb loops blended by input direction, with IK holding hands and feet to any wall
Body tilts with the slope, so climbing flattens into walking on all fours as the wall lies back
Effort shows on the body: a rhythmic bounce, glancing at the next hold, sweat drops, a panicked scramble when stamina runs out
motion.lesson: A small keyed set plus IK lets a character climb anything; show effort on the body instead of a meter.

sources.title: New Frame Plus: How Link's climbing animation works in Breath of the Wild (transcript)

motion.source: oracle motion study 2026-10-23 (public talks, interviews and breakdowns; no game files)

identity.audio_mood: Sparse piano, nature sounds, music swelling for fights and towns.
identity.lessons_for_abbies_world: Climb anything, with a stamina wheel that appears only while it matters, and a body that shows effort. The world is the quest log.
